Unlock Basic Armor
An asari named Mallene Calis asked you to speak to Rafael Vargas on her behalf. You told her you were too busy. If you change your mind, speak to her again.
Vargas is at the hotel bar. In order for Mallene's device to work, you have to keep him talking about business. He is a shrewd man who can tell if someone's wasting his time.
Keep Him Talking
An asari named Mallene Calis has asked you to wiretap Rafael Vargas. She gave you a device that will hack into his personal network as you speak to him.
An asari named Mallene Calis asked you to spy on Rafael Vargas. You refused.
Vargas became suspicious and left. You should tell Mallene her plan failed.
Cover Blown
You told Vargas about Mallene's plot. She is still expecting you to return.
Turned Mallene In
An asari named Mallene Calis asked you to spy on Rafael Vargas. You did as she asked.
An asari named Mallene Calis asked you to spy on Rafael Vargas. The plan failed when he became suspicious.
You've successfully hacked into Vargas' network. Return to Mallene Callis.
Hacking Complete
An asari named Mallene Calis asked you to spy on Rafael Vargas. You quit the job before completion.

An asari named Mallene Calis asked you to spy on Rafael Vargas. The plan failed when he became suspicious. You admitted the plot to him and turned over Mallene's cracking device, but afterwards warned the asari.
An asari named Mallene Calis asked you to spy on Rafael Vargas. You admitted the plot to him and turned over Mallene's cracking device. He will use it to feed the asari false information.

Dr. Cohen told you that several of the scientists at Rift Station were sickened by an experiment gone awry. Captain Ventralis won't allow anyone to go into the labs to manufacture a cure for them. He might make an exception in your case.
You'll need to ask Ventralis for permission to enter the quarantine labs.
Talk to Ventralis
Head to the quarantine lab, which is downstairs near the science team quarters. There should be equipment and notes that will allow you to replicate the scientists' work and create a cure.
Make a Cure
You've got the cure. Return it to Dr. Cohen in the infirmary.
Return to Cohen
Several of the scientists at Rift Station were sickened by an experiment gone awry. You went into the contaminated labs to make a cure for them; they should recover in time.
Given the chaos caused by your breaking into the secret labs, you no longer have time to deal with this.

Saren appears to have discovered a cure for the genophage and is breeding an army of krogan. Wrex is furious that Captain Kirrahe wants to destroy the cure. The Captain is worried about Wrex's state of mind and doesn't want to continue if Wrex is going to be a problem.
Virmire: Wrex and the Genophage
Wrex couldn't be reasoned with and you decided to kill him rather than risk the mission.
Virmire: Wrex is Dead
Wrex couldn't be reasoned with and you decided to have Ashley kill him rather than risk the mission.
You tried to reason with Wrex but he became violent and Ashley killed him rather than risk losing you.
Speak with Wrex and calm him down.
Talk to Wrex
You convinced Wrex that destroying the genophage was the best thing for everyone, including the krogan. He isn't happy about it, but at least he understands.
Virmire: Wrex is Convinced
Platform
Someone has been killing every Alliance scientist who was involved in a secret project years ago. The only project member still alive is located in the Newton System of the Kepler Verge.
UNC: Dead Scientists

Years ago, a group of Alliance scientists conducted a secret project on Akuze, the planet where your entire unit was wiped out. Now someone is killing those scientists. The only project member still alive is located in the Newton system of the Kepler Verge.
You killed Toombs, the man threatening the Alliance scientist.
You killed Toombs in order to stop him from killing the Alliance scientist responsible for the secret experiments at Akuze. The scientist can now go to trial for his crimes.
You allowed Toombs to kill the scientist who performed experiments on him after the massacre at Akuze. Toombs then took his own life.

You convinced Toombs to let the scientist live so he could stand trial for his actions. Toombs can now get the therapy he needs after his years of torture, and the scientist will spend the rest of his life in prison.
You killed the scientist yourself so Toombs would not have to do so. Toombs can now get the therapy he needs, and no one will question a Spectre's decision.
Go to the Newton System in the Kepler Verge cluster and find the one remaining scientist assigned to the secret project.
Find the Scientist
With the situation resolved, you should now make your report to Admiral Hackett.
Report to Hackett
You've discovered a locator signal for a major geth military installation. The geth are using the facility as a base of operations for their recent incursions into the Armstrong Cluster.
Find and destroy the main geth base of operations in the Grissom System of the Armstrong Nebula cluster in order to stop the geth incursion.
Eliminate Geth Bunker
You have destroyed the geth bases and the geth bunker. For the moment, at least, the geth offensive has been halted.
You've arrived at Peak 15. The station is shut down.
You've restored the Mira Virtual Intelligence.
Confirm Secondary Training

An old Alliance espionage probe has turned up in the Voyager Cluster. These probes carried nuclear payloads, and if the Citadel discovers these nuclear booby-traps, it would greatly embarrass the Alliance. Your mission is to find, disable, and recover the probe.
UNC: Espionage Probe
The probe was a trap set specifically to lure you in. Elanos Haliat, the man who masterminded the attack on Elysium, wants revenge on the Alliance for his defeat.
The probe was a trap set specifically to lure you in. Elanos Haliat, the man who masterminded the attack on Elysium, wants revenge on you for heroically holding the line.
The probe's signal is coming from the Amazon System in the Voyager cluster. Head there and track it down.
Find the Probe
Escape from the trap that Haliat has left for you. If possible, take down Haliat, as well.
You escaped from the trap Haliat laid for you and managed to kill him in the process.
Waste Container
Many systems will be inoperable until the equipment is repaired. Getting the computers operating would be a logical first step.
Power Down
Peak 15's Virtual Intelligence computer program has suffered some kind of failure, and requires a manual reboot.
Computers Damaged
You informed Admiral Kahoku of the fate of his men. Kahoku has promised to investigate their deaths further.
Ventralis told you that Benezia went to the Hot Labs. He gave you a pass to an elevator by the trams that can take you there.
Benezia Left
You've discovered a sealed section of the Rift Station labs. It would be possible to blast your way in, but there may be a more subtle way.
The Sealed Labs
You've entered an unguarded "back door" into the sealed areas of Rift Station. The guards are not alerted to your presence.
Sneaking In
You've broken into the sealed areas of Rift Station. The station is on alert, and the guards will shoot to kill.
Breaking In
You have the card needed to arm the neutron purge. Use it on the controls in the Operations Center.
The Pass Card

Admiral Hackett has asked you to negotiate a treaty with a man named Darius in the Plutus System system. The treaty concerns mining rights on an asteroid rich in Element Zero. You are authorized to make any financial or diplomatic concessions necessary to secure mining rights to the asteroid.
UNC: The Negotiation
You have successfully negotiated a treaty with the warlord Darius. Admiral Hackett was surprised but pleased that you managed to solve the matter without hostilities.

You killed Darius and destabilized the region, which was apparently what Admiral Hackett was secretly hoping all along. With Darius dead, the criminal elements will be too busy fighting each other to mount attacks on the miners.
Meet Darius at the rendezvous point on the planet Nonuel in the Plutus System of the Hades Gamma cluster.
Meet Darius
Make whatever concessions are necessary to secure the treaty with Darius.
Negotiate Treaty
Return to the Normandy and use the galaxy map to report the successful treaty negotiation to Admiral Hackett.
Return to the Normandy and use the galaxy map to report the death of Darius to Admiral Hackett.
Negotiation Parameters
